column1: 1) Go to Settings and choose mode(s): Questionnaire, Picks, or Both. Adjust scoring weights.
2) Add games (or series/season rows) in Games.
3) For each game, enter your questionnaire answers in Questionnaire_Answers.
5) Paste actual results (or import) into Results.
• The template includes a placeholder 'Import' sheet for API pulls. If you later automate, feed Results/Players from your script.
• Extra-innings rule: you can enable 'Questionnaire Only If Extra Innings' in Settings.
• All blue-text cells are meant for user input.
